correctness.rationale: The stable linear oscillator with a bounded telegraph force has a unique bounded stationary law. Applying the exact generator to moments through total degree four yields finite invertible linear systems. Independent symbolic reconstruction and rational substitution confirm Cov(q²,p²)=-4 rho P/H; each denominator factor is strictly positive, dP/drho>0, dP/dg>0, and P(g,0)=3(6g²-1)(g²+3). These facts prove the unique decreasing zero curve, sign diagram, and endpoint limits for all g,rho>0. The standalone checker passed 135 exact assertions; its finite sample assertions do not substitute for the analytic sign argument.

value.rationale: The mixed kinetic–potential energy covariance detects a nontrivial fourth-order dependency invisible to identically zero position–velocity covariance. Its exact universal sign phase diagram reveals a previously nonobvious switch from positively to negatively correlated energy fluctuations; a sharp damping cutoff and a strictly decreasing flipping-rate boundary provide structural information throughout the full physical parameter domain. This is motivated by fluctuation coupling in persistent-noise inertial confinement, not by an arbitrary numerical slice, and is not implied by known marginal variances or kurtoses. Limits to symmetric Poisson driving and linear traps are explicit.
